ja323:1.1: Dvayaṃ yācanako rāja Brahmadatta nigacchati: (Vol.II 167|6.) alābhaṃ dhanalābhaṃ vā, evaṃdhammā hi yācanā. ḥ
ja323:2.1: Yācanaṃ rodanaṃ āhu Pañcālānaṃ rathesabha, yo ca naṃ paccakkhāti tam āhu paṭirodanaṃ.
ja323:3.1: Mā m' addasaṃsu rodantaṃ Pañcālā susamāgatā tavaṃ vā paṭirodantaṃ, tasmā icchām' ahaṃ raho ti.
ja323:4.1: Dadāmi te brāhmaṇa rohiṇīnaṃ (Cfr.vol.II.320|16) gavaṃ sahassaṃ saha puṅgavena, ariyo hi ariyassa kathaṃ na dajjā sutvāna gāthā tava dhammayuttā ti.
